Use case: illustration-story. New wide cinematic cover for The ARC Daily Digest morning edition, November 2 2026. Shared character reference system https://arc.markbarney.net/news/cards . Use both input images as CHARACTER AND VEHICLE references for a NEW episode, not a collage or crop. Image 1 is the user's snowy race scene and governs Turducken's seven-character crew, two Yorkies, brass/cobalt bird machine, and exuberant painted style. Image 2 governs NVIDIA NVARC3's massive green GPU caterpillar juggernaut and its four established characters. Current story: NVIDIA NVARC3 is FOURTH, just ahead of FIFTH Team Turducken. Illustrate that local battle; neither vehicle is first overall. Do not depict other entrants or a finish-line victory.
NEW SCENE: 'The Morning Hairpin'. A wide alpine racetrack turns sharply around a snowy rocky spur above a spectacular ice-blue gorge. The camera sees both vehicles from a slightly elevated three-quarter SIDE view, travelling left to right along the SAME broad curve. The huge NVIDIA tracked GPU juggernaut occupies center-right and is CLEARLY AHEAD, its front farther right along the road than the Turducken bird's beak. Turducken is left-center immediately behind, its wings fanned for balance and skids spraying snow as it takes the bend. Show two separate entire vehicle silhouettes, no fusion, no confusing reversed direction, no collision. Low golden morning sun through snowy pine trees; snowy mountain amphitheater and immense GPU towers far away. Strong speed, fun, camaraderie and determined expressions. No weapons. A snow plume traces their route.
NVIDIA deck: keep the four established characters from image2 visible on the open deck: bearded spectacle-wearing CPMP commander in green brass cybergear; Gal with swept hair and red flight jacket; Darragh as completely OPAQUE blue/gold celestial spiral face and cloak, absolutely no invented human face; clean-shaven Ivan with cyan-lit glasses at a glowing cyan prism console. Small anonymous helmeted GPU engineers can occupy the rear, no named likeness added.
Turducken deck: all SEVEN recognizable characters from image1 together, no riders omitted or duplicated: burly tattooed bearded Mark at wheel; Son with blue visor at laptop; Keith separate little yellow black-capped duck mascot; blonde DZ holding her pink plush rabbit; NT as yellow bird with black eyebrows, half-lidded eyes and large ochre beak; Choryu as grayscale MRI-screen head; silver/cobalt knight Herminator with blue plume. Exactly TWO little Yorkies together on front rail. The bird vehicle has brass articulated feather wings and a recognizably turkey/chicken head. Keep its vivid copper, turquoise and cobalt machinery. No additional generic human riders or banana kitten.
STYLE: spectacular polished comic-book painting matching provided references, glamorized illustrated faces, coherent light, intricate brushed metal, airy snow, crisp silhouettes and saturated warm/cool contrast. Panoramic landscape, detailed enough to read both crews at full resolution. This must be a fresh camera, action and setting, not the old workshop or a near-copy of the supplied race. Keep all main faces away from top and bottom edges; a separate data footer will be added later. CLEAN ART ONLY: no text, names, logos, ranks, digits, scoreboard, panels, newspaper masthead, borders or watermarks.
